newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BNDES picks advisors on sale of Brazil power firms.
newsitem.headline: BNDES picks advisors on sale of Brazil power firms.

text.p: Two consortia, one led by Banco Graphus and another by Deutsche Bank, were awarded contracts to advise on the sale of Brazilian power generators Eletrosul and Furnas, the BNDES said.
Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said the Graphus-led consortium will be hired for the so-called "B" service, which consists of a financial and economic evaluation and privatization model.
The group led by Deutsche Bank will also provide a financial and economic evaluation and a technical and operational analysis of both firms under the "A" service, it added.
The price asked by the winning consortium for the "A" service was 1.49 million reais, while the price asked by the group that won the "B" service was 1.918 million reais, BNDES said.
The contracts are expected to be signed 15 working days after the results of the bidding process are published on the Official Gazette, it said.
Eletrosul and Furnas are units of federal Eletrobras system.
